figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS feb_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY feb_orders DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;

parts.label: 取数
parts.note: 输出 c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS feb_orders。
